articles.description: QUALCOMM affirmed a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.92 per share for December 2026 while reporting a 16.67% year on year decline in diluted EPS, a 20.00 P/E ratio and a 2.03% dividend yield, alongside weaker operating margins.
